entities.name: Littleton Waller Tazewell
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Littleton Waller Tazewell was a Virginia lawyer, plantation owner, and politician who served as a U.S. representative, U.S. senator and the 26th governor of Virginia, as well as a member of the Virginia House of Delegates.
